_comment: Forecast texts (transits). {b} is the natal point's theme from aspects.json. 'flowing' = trine/sextile, 'tense' = square/opposition. Describe themes and timing, never fixed events.

conjunction.meaning: Jupiter is visiting {b}, which can bring a hopeful, expansive mood to this part of your life. Doors may open more easily than usual.
conjunction.howToUseIt: Say yes to chances to learn and grow, while keeping your plans realistic.

flowing.meaning: Jupiter is supporting {b}, so this can be an encouraging time to build confidence and reach out.
flowing.howToUseIt: Use the extra optimism to start something you have been putting off.

tense.meaning: Jupiter is stretching {b}, which can bring big ideas and a pull to do more than usual.
tense.howToUseIt: Aim high, but watch for overdoing it or promising too much.

conjunction.meaning: Saturn is sitting on {b}, which can feel like a time of tests and new responsibilities. It can also be when you build something solid and lasting.
conjunction.howToUseIt: Focus on one or two goals, keep steady habits and be patient with yourself.

flowing.meaning: Saturn is steadying {b}, which can make this a good time for patient work and practical progress.
flowing.howToUseIt: Make plans, commit to them and let small steps add up.

tense.meaning: Saturn is testing {b}, so things may feel slower or heavier for a while. Steady effort now can make you stronger.
tense.howToUseIt: Rest when you need to, ask for help and keep going one step at a time.

conjunction.meaning: Uranus is waking up {b}, which can bring surprises, restlessness and a strong wish for change.
conjunction.howToUseIt: Stay open to new ideas, but make big changes one step at a time.

flowing.meaning: Uranus is refreshing {b}, so new ideas and helpful changes may come more easily.
flowing.howToUseIt: Try something new or experiment with a different way of doing things.

tense.meaning: Uranus is shaking up {b}, which can bring sudden changes or a push to break old patterns.
tense.howToUseIt: Keep some flexibility in your plans and give yourself room to adjust.

conjunction.meaning: Neptune is softening {b}, which can bring dreamy, sensitive or inspired feelings. Things may feel less clear than usual.
conjunction.howToUseIt: Make time for art, rest and reflection, and double-check important details.

flowing.meaning: Neptune is inspiring {b}, so creativity, kindness and intuition may flow more easily.
flowing.howToUseIt: Follow gentle hunches and give time to creative or caring projects.

tense.meaning: Neptune is blurring {b}, so you may feel unsure or easily drained for a while.
tense.howToUseIt: Keep clear boundaries, rest well and wait for clarity before big decisions.

conjunction.meaning: Pluto is deepening {b}, which can bring intense feelings and a slow, powerful change in this part of your life.
conjunction.howToUseIt: Let go of what no longer fits, and trust that real change takes time.

flowing.meaning: Pluto is empowering {b}, so this can be a good time for deep, lasting improvements.
flowing.howToUseIt: Dig into what matters most to you and put your energy there.

tense.meaning: Pluto is pushing {b} to transform, which can bring pressure or power struggles for a while.
tense.howToUseIt: Notice where you hold on too tightly, and choose honest, steady change.

houseTopics.1: you and how you show up
houseTopics.2: your values and sense of security

ingress.Jupiter: Jupiter moves into your {n} house ({topic}), bringing a focus on growth there over the coming months.
ingress.Saturn: Saturn moves into your {n} house ({topic}), asking for structure and steady effort there over the next few years.
ingress.Uranus: Uranus moves into your {n} house ({topic}), bringing fresh starts and change there for years to come.
ingress.Neptune: Neptune moves into your {n} house ({topic}), bringing more sensitivity and imagination there for years to come.
ingress.Pluto: Pluto moves into your {n} house ({topic}), starting a long, deep transformation there.

ingressBack: {body} moves back into your {n} house ({topic}) for a while as it turns retrograde.
